three functions:

1. **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in `src/num.js` — uses early returns to limit the value to the inclusive range
2. **`formatBytes(n)`** in `src/util.js` — converts bytes to human-readable format (B, KB, MB, GB) with one decimal place
3. **`slugify(title)`** in `src/text.js` — lowercases, trims, replaces spaces with dashes, and removes non-alphanumeric characters (except dashes)

All follow the project's style guide: two-space indents, early returns, and no unnecessary abstractions.
